# Fast Launch

> Fast Launch is a UK web studio building premium, conversion-focused custom websites and production-ready MVPs in 3-14 days. No agencies, no retainers, fully owned by you.

Fast Launch (fastlaunchmvp.com) is run by Jack Wilson. We ship modern, scalable products on Next.js, TypeScript, Supabase, PostgreSQL and Vercel. Every engagement is fixed-scope, fixed-price, with daily build previews and 100% code ownership from day one.

## Core URLs

- [Home](https://fastlaunchmvp.com/): Overview, positioning, services, pricing, testimonials, FAQ.
- [Services](https://fastlaunchmvp.com/services): MVP development, UI/UX design, full-stack development, launch & scale — with deliverables and tech stack.
- [Work](https://fastlaunchmvp.com/work): Selected case studies of shipped products.
- [Contact](https://fastlaunchmvp.com/contact): Project brief intake form. Reply within 24 hours.

## Services

- Production-Ready MVPs in 3-14 days (Next.js + TypeScript, auth & payments, daily build previews, 100% code ownership).
- UI/UX Design (wireframes, clickable prototypes, mobile-first layouts, design systems).
- Full-Stack Development (React/Next.js frontend, Node.js + PostgreSQL backend, Stripe/SendGrid/Twilio integrations, CI/CD + tests).
- Launch & Scale (Vercel/AWS deploys, uptime monitoring, error tracking, SEO + analytics, post-launch support).

## Case Studies

- [Eliminent](https://fastlaunchmvp.com/work/eliminent): AI-powered social deduction game. Real-time multiplayer, 4-12 players, sub-100ms latency. Shipped in 8 days.
- [Metalex Terminal](https://fastlaunchmvp.com/work/metalex-terminal): Professional-grade precious metals trading terminal with live spot prices, AI signals, futures curves. Shipped in 14 days.
- [Desert Falcons Collective](https://fastlaunchmvp.com/work/desert-falcons): Premium automotive community platform for the Middle East luxury car scene. Shipped in 7 days.
- [Memory Market](https://fastlaunchmvp.com/work/memory-market): Web3 marketplace where AI memory becomes a tradeable on-chain asset on Solana. Shipped in 9 days.
- [Aramas Property](https://fastlaunchmvp.com/work/aramas-property): UAE off-plan property marketplace with advanced search and developer profiles. Shipped in 6 days.
- [Insights Dashboard](https://fastlaunchmvp.com/work/insights-dashboard): Real-time business KPI dashboard pulling from Stripe, HubSpot, GA4, PostgreSQL. Shipped in 5 days.
- [AMS Tool](https://fastlaunchmvp.com/work/ams-tool): AI-powered adverse media screening platform for compliance teams. Shipped in 10 days.
- [Speed Read](https://fastlaunchmvp.com/work/speed-read): RSVP-powered speed reading tool with browser extension. Shipped in 7 days.

## Positioning

- 3-14 days to production vs. 3-6 month agency timelines.
- Fixed-scope, fixed-price packages. No retainers. No hourly billing surprises.
- Direct line to the developer building it. No account managers.
- Modern stack only: Next.js, TypeScript, React, Supabase, PostgreSQL, Tailwind, Vercel.
- 100% code ownership and IP transfer on delivery.
- Post-launch support included. Money-back guarantee.
